next =  (((huff + 0 < huff_end) ? huff[0] : 0x00) << 24) +
        (((huff + 1 < huff_end) ? huff[1] : 0x00) << 16) +
        (((huff + 2 < huff_end) ? huff[2] : 0x00) <<  8) +
        ((huff + 3 < huff_end) ? huff[3] : 0x00);
```

This is safe - it checks each byte before reading.
